concepts.name: Limit Of A Function
concepts.simple_definition: The limit is the value that a function approaches as the input approaches some value.
concepts.deep_explanation: We write lim (x->c) f(x) = L. For the limit to exist, both the left-hand limit and right-hand limit must exist and be equal.
concepts.real_example: lim (x->2) (x² - 4)/(x - 2) = lim (x->2) (x+2) = 4, even though the function is undefined at x = 2.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking the limit value must equal the function value at that point. A function can have a limit at c even if f(c) is undefined.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ሊሚት ማለት ተለዋዋጩ (input) ወደ አንድ እሴት ሲጠጋ ፈንክሽኑ የሚጠጋበት ዋጋ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: lim (x->c) f(x) = L ተብሎ ይጻፋል። ሊሚት ለመኖር ከቀኝና ከግራ ያሉት ሊሚቶች እኩል መሆን አለባቸው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ፈንክሽኑ በ x = 2 ላይ ባይገለጽም፣ lim (x->2) (x² - 4)/(x - 2) = lim (x->2) (x+2) = 4 ነው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የሊሚት ዋጋ በዚያ ነጥብ ላይ ካለው የፈንክሽኑ እሴት ጋር እኩል መሆን አለበት ብሎ ማሰብ።
